messages:
maya: Heads-up — int8 bringup for quant4b is showing a regression on our anchorset. Rough numbers: anchorset n=2400, fail-rate increased by ~12%. Mostly policy + finance intents. Need targeted golden refresh and a quick relabel pass. cc @owen @zara :exclamation:

owen: Do we have a breakdown by intent and delta examples?

maya: Quick breakdown: policy=48% of fails, finance=30%, misc=22%. We're pulling high delta conf examples (float.conf >= 0.9 and score_delta > 0.12). Grabbing 200 highest-impact samples for relabel. Extraction used:```python
# sample high-impact mismatches
python tools/sample_golden.py --dataset anchorset --filter "score_delta>0.12 and conf_float>=0.9" --limit 200 --tag relabel_quant4b_int8
```

labeler-bot: 200 items queued to curation:golden_relabel_queue (priority=high). Estimated ETA: ~2h.

zara: Are we changing rubric for quant-related errors or keeping binary pass/fail? Last quant patch required rubric tweaks.

maya: Keep binary for now: PASS/FAIL/AMBIGUOUS. Short rubric: exact match -> PASS; paraphrase but same meaning -> PASS; missing required info or hallucination -> FAIL; unclear -> AMBIGUOUS (add one-line note).

sam: I'll run a canary relabel and follow with regression run. @jen can you assign labeler rotation (3 ppl)?

jen: Assigned: @kevin (80), @anita (60), @lia (60). Use doc `golden_relabel_v2` and add `golden_relabel_v2` tag on comments. QA threshold: 95% majority agreement. 2+ conflicting labels -> escalate to @maya for adjudication.

kevin: Acknowledged. Quick question — do we capture labeler confidence?

jen: Yes, include confidence 1-5 in the comment meta.

labeler-bot: Batch assigned to kevin/anita/lia. Progress will be posted.

owen: After relabel, run regression harness: `scripts/regress.py --models float32,quant4b-int8 --dataset anchorset --out out/regress_int8.json`. Also log diffs to dashboard path `quant:onboard/anchorset-int8`.

maya: Plan: relabel today, regress EOD. If regression >8% on a priority slice we rollback int8 canary. Sam will coordinate rollback window.

sam: Rollback standby command: `deploy rollback quant4b-int8 --tag canary-2026-03-21` (do not run until I give thumbs).

labeler-bot: Progress update: 70/200 completed; 18 ambiguous; 3 escalated to maya.

zara: Make sure PMs and support know — link regress CSV and a few representative examples to #eng-ml and the PM ticket.

maya: Will paste diffs and representative fails once harness finishes. Thanks all.

labeler-bot: Final update: 200/200 labeled. Consensus: 175 PASS, 20 FAIL, 5 AMBIGUOUS, 0 escalations remaining.

sam: Kicking off regress now. Will post results when ready.

labeler-bot: Regression run complete: float32 pass-rate 92.3%, int8 pass-rate 80.1% (delta 12.2%). Policy slice drop = 15.8%, finance slice drop = 10.5%.

own: That's >8% threshold on multiple slices. Maya, recommend rollback.

maya: Agreed. Sam, please coordinate rollback and notify affected customers. Also request postmortem to capture quant calibration and kernel differences.

sam: Rolling back canary now. Command executed: `deploy rollback quant4b-int8 --tag canary-2026-03-21` — canary stopped. Posting incident ticket and scheduling a follow-up meeting tomorrow.

zara: Action items: 1) investigate quant kernels and tokenization edgecases; 2) expand golden to include more finance/policy edgecases; 3) add quant A/B tests pre-canary next time.

maya: Adding action items to tracker. Thanks team for quick turnaround.
